topic: 3 AI tools that saved me 10 hours this week
angle: Not headline tools. The three quiet workhorses that actually give hours back.
hook: 3 AI tools that quietly saved me 10 hours this week — none are ChatGPT
caption:
Everyone lists ChatGPT and Claude. Fine. But the tools that actually give me hours back are quieter. Three specific ones ran in the background all week and did jobs I used to do by hand. The pattern: they replace a boring task, not a creative one. What is your most-used boring-task AI tool?

slides.text: 3 AI tools that quietly saved me 10 hours this week — none are ChatGPT
